situations.title: 손위생·PPE 착탈
situations.tagline: Should I be wearing a gown and gloves before I touch my dad?
situations.brief: 표준주의에 따라 손위생과 PPE 착탈을 정확히 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: Please clean your hands with the gel before and after visiting.
Put the gown on first, then the gloves, before you go in.
When you leave, remove the gloves first, then the gown.

situations.title: CLABSI 번들 유지
situations.tagline: What's that big line in his neck, and how do you keep it from getting infected?
situations.brief: 중심라인 관리로 CLABSI 번들을 일관되게 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: This central line lets us give medications safely into a large vein.
We keep the dressing clean and dry to prevent infection.
We check it every day and remove it as soon as it's no longer needed.

situations.title: CAUTI 예방·조기 제거
situations.tagline: Does she still need that catheter, or can it come out soon?
situations.brief: 도뇨 필요성을 재평가해 CAUTI를 예방하고 조기 제거하세요.
keyPhrases: We check every day whether she still needs the urinary catheter.
Removing it early lowers the risk of a bladder infection.
I'll bring it up with the team on today's rounds.

situations.title: VAP 번들 수행
situations.tagline: Why is the head of his bed always raised up like that?
situations.brief: HOB 상승과 구강간호로 VAP 번들을 정확히 수행하세요.
keyPhrases: We keep the head of the bed raised to protect his lungs.
Regular mouth care helps prevent ventilator-related pneumonia.
These small steps lower his risk of infection while he's on the breathing machine.

situations.title: 격리 유형 이해·표지
situations.tagline: There's a yellow sign on the door — what does contact isolation mean for us?
situations.brief: 접촉·비말·공기 격리 유형과 표지를 정확히 이해시키세요.
keyPhrases: That sign means we use gowns and gloves for contact isolation.
Different colors tell us what protection each germ needs.
Following the sign keeps you, him, and other patients safe.

situations.title: 환경·기구 소독
situations.tagline: Do you clean all this equipment between patients?
situations.brief: 교차감염 예방을 위해 환경과 기구를 철저히 소독하세요.
keyPhrases: Yes, we disinfect the equipment and surfaces between each use.
This prevents germs from spreading between patients.
Shared devices get wiped down before they come to the bedside.

situations.title: 중심라인 드레싱·관리 최적화
situations.tagline: The dressing on his line looks a little loose — is that a problem?
situations.brief: 중심라인 드레싱과 관리를 최적화해 CLABSI를 감소시키세요.
keyPhrases: Thanks for noticing — a loose dressing can let germs in.
I'll change it using a sterile technique right away.
Keeping it sealed and dry is key to preventing a line infection.

situations.title: VAP 예방 통합 번들 준수
situations.tagline: I'm double-checking our VAP bundle compliance on this vented patient.
situations.brief: 다요소 통합 번들을 준수해 VAP를 예방하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's confirm head elevation, oral care, and sedation breaks are all done.
Every element of the bundle needs to be met for it to count.
I'll document our compliance for the infection team.

situations.title: 도뇨관 필요성 매일 평가
situations.tagline: Let's review which of our patients still actually need their Foleys today.
situations.brief: 조기 제거 문화를 위해 도뇨관 필요성을 매일 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's check each patient's indication for the catheter today.
If there's no clear reason, we should remove it.
Daily review helps us cut down on CAUTIs.

situations.title: 격리 환자 이송 감염관리
situations.tagline: We need to take this MDRO patient to CT — how do we keep transport clean?
situations.brief: 이송 중 감염 차단을 위해 격리 환자 이송을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's put a clean sheet over the patient and cover any lines.
We'll notify CT ahead so they can prepare the room.
Staff should wear PPE and disinfect the scanner afterward.
goals: 이송 중 감염 차단 조치를 시행한다

situations.title: MDRO 보균 관리·코호팅
situations.tagline: Two of our patients grew the same resistant bug — should we cohort them?
situations.brief: 확산 방지를 위해 MDRO 보균자를 관리하고 코호팅하세요.
keyPhrases: Both patients carry the same resistant organism, so we can cohort them.
Dedicated staff and equipment help limit the spread.
Let's flag them clearly and reinforce contact precautions.

situations.title: C. difficile 예방·관리
situations.tagline: He's had a lot of diarrhea — could this be C. diff?
situations.brief: 접촉주의와 환경 관리로 C. difficile를 예방하고 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: His diarrhea could be C. diff, so let's send a stool sample.
We need soap and water, not just gel, for hand hygiene here.
Bleach-based cleaning is required to kill the spores.

situations.title: 항생제 관련 이차감염 감시
situations.tagline: He's been on broad antibiotics for a while — I'm watching for a secondary infection.
situations.brief: 이차감염 인지를 위해 항생제 관련 징후를 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: Long antibiotic courses can lead to secondary infections like C. diff or yeast.
Let's watch for new fever, diarrhea, or oral thrush.
I'll flag any new signs to the team early.

situations.title: 장치 관련 감염 조기 인지
situations.tagline: The skin around his central line looks a bit red today.
situations.brief: 국소·전신 징후를 통해 장치 관련 감염을 조기에 인지하세요.
keyPhrases: The redness around the line could be an early sign of infection.
Let's check for fever, tenderness, or drainage too.
I'll notify the team so we can decide whether to remove it.
goals: 장치 관련 감염의 국소·전신 징후를 사정한다

situations.title: 감염관리 팀 보고·소통
situations.tagline: The infection control nurse wants an update on our new MDRO case.
situations.brief: surveillance 협조를 위해 감염관리 팀에 정확히 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll report the new positive culture and the isolation status.
Let me give them the onset date and precautions in place.
We'll follow their guidance on any additional measures.

situations.title: 원내감염 클러스터 대응
situations.tagline: Three patients on the unit grew the same organism this week — I think we have a cluster.
situations.brief: outbreak 협조를 위해 원내감염 클러스터에 신속히 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Three cases of the same organism suggest a possible outbreak.
Let's alert infection control and reinforce precautions now.
We may need cohorting, screening, and an environmental review.

situations.title: 공기매개 병원체 노출 위기
situations.tagline: The patient in bed 4 may have TB — was anyone in there without an N95?
situations.brief: N95와 음압 관리로 공기매개 병원체 노출 위기에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: This patient needs a negative-pressure room right away.
Everyone entering must wear a fit-tested N95.
Let's identify anyone exposed without protection and report it.

situations.title: 다제내성균 패혈증 확산 위기
situations.tagline: This CRE sepsis patient could spread fast — are our precautions tight enough?
situations.brief: 격리를 강화해 다제내성균 패혈증 확산 위기를 통제하세요.
keyPhrases: This resistant organism can spread quickly, so we must tighten isolation.
Dedicated equipment and strict hand hygiene are essential now.
Let's screen contacts and reinforce every precaution.

situations.title: 주삿바늘 노출사고 대응
situations.tagline: I just stuck myself with a needle from an infected patient — what do I do?
situations.brief: PEP와 보고 절차에 따라 주삿바늘 노출사고에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: First, wash the site well with soap and water.
We need to report this and get you evaluated for PEP right away.
Let's check the source patient's status and start the protocol.

situations.title: 면역저하 보호격리 붕괴 위기
situations.tagline: 환자는 심한 면역저하 상태로, 무너진 보호격리로 인해 감염 위험이 급격히 높아진 위기 상황이다.
situations.brief: 역격리 관리로 면역저하 환자의 보호격리 붕괴 위기에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: His immune system is severely low, so we must protect him from all germs.
Only healthy, gowned staff should enter, and no live plants or flowers.
Let's restore full protective isolation immediately.

situations.title: 감염 대유행 자원 배분 윤리
situations.tagline: We're short on isolation rooms during this outbreak — how do we decide who gets one?
situations.brief: 팀·정책 소통을 통해 감염 대유행 시 자원 배분 윤리를 다루세요.
keyPhrases: We're limited on isolation rooms, so we prioritize by transmission risk.
Let's follow the hospital's allocation policy, not individual judgment.
I'll escalate to leadership so decisions stay fair and consistent.
goals: 자원 배분 우선순위를 정책에 따라 판단한다
